id: title:CShine612:keep a cleared number input empty while typing

observations.behavior: Adds state tracking for cleared number inputs; P1.F2 adds tests asserting that clearing an input does not immediately restore fallback values.
observations.posthog_connection: Could prevent unintended fallback restoration in PostHog dashboards using LemonInput with type='number'.

observations.behavior: Computes display value to show '' instead of NaN or undefined during focused editing, preserving controlled behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves React control contract for number fields used by PostHog frontend components.

observations.behavior: Resets draft-empty flag on Enter and blur, committing the user-entered value rather than restoring a fallback.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to complete partial numbers without losing their entry before submission.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks reviewed. No backend or shared dependency changes examined. Tests are isolated but do not demonstrate production adoption.

review.limitations: Only three hunks reviewed. No backend or shared dependency changes examined. Tests are isolated but do not demonstrate production adoption.
review.reason: Substantive bounded correctness improvement: fixes edge-case behavior where clearing a number field could lose typed input or break React's controlled/uncontrolled distinction. Implementation and relevant checks are visible. Not tier 3 because no broader systemic change is demonstrated across multiple critical paths.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant if PostHog uses LemonInput for numeric filters, warehouse settings, or other dashboard inputs; could preserve expected UX when users clear and retype values.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on this chunk; wider context of LemonInput usage and test execution results unavailable.
